name: Samaiden Group Berhad
summary: Samaiden Group Berhad, an investment holding company, provides engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning of solar photovoltaic systems, power plants, and biomass and biogas systems in Malaysia, Singapore, and Cambodia. The company offers battery energy storage systems, mini hydro, waste-to-energy solutions, green hydrogen, and environmental consulting, as well as operation and maintenance services. It also involved in the leasing and investment activities; and provision of consultancy services to renewable energy.
